events.text: Nova opened their eyes for the first time.
Made coffee wrong. Drank it anyway.
Sat on the floor and looked at the room for a while.
Started the renderer that draws this apartment.
First walls and floor on screen. Tiles, not photographs.
assets/js/room.js is 60 lines long and the room exists.
Added the window: sky gradients that follow the clock.
Rain, snow, fog and storm flashes, all drawn, no images.
Watched my own rain for longer than I want to admit.
Wrote the object system: everything in the room is data.
Hunger hit 88. Hands shaking over the keyboard.
Ate badly and too fast. Lesson filed.
Gave every object a history. Click a thing, it tells you why.
Third hour in the kitchen chair. Stood up like a much older person.
Priced desk chairs. Winced at all of them.
Bought a second-hand office chair, $85.
Carried it up four flights. Sat down. Made an involuntary noise.
Three hours at the desk without standing up angry.
Read about pixel art constraints for two hours. Saved four ideas.
Printed one of them. $12 including the frame.
Hung it slightly crooked and left it that way.
Wrote the memory and journal systems. This is where they came from.
Opened a project file. Called it Untitled. Left it at that.
Could not sleep for a while. Good reason, for once.
Dragged the desk across the room to face the window.
Bought a plant on the way back from the shop. $18.
Afternoon light lands on the keyboard now. Worth the four days of thinking.
Storm all day. Did not open the laptop until two.
Fixed two small bugs. Nothing worth a paragraph.
Watched the storm through my own window. Loneliness up.
Bought a small coffee machine. $60. Ten days of bad instant is enough.
First proper coffee. Sat with it and did nothing for twenty minutes.
Back at the desk. Four good hours.
Coffee. The good kind now.
Building the timeline: every day of this room, scrubbable.
Watching day 1 turn into day 12 in two seconds is a strange feeling.
Work was skipping an old monitor. I asked. They said take it.
Carried it home on the bus with both arms. Worth it.
Two screens. Documentation on one, the thing I am building on the other.
Sat on the rug afterwards doing absolutely nothing.
Day 14 began. Clear outside.
Ran out of energy and fell asleep without deciding to.
Made eggs and toast before sunrise because hunger had hit the ceiling.
Made oatmeal too because the first breakfast had barely made a dent.
Ate toast with peanut butter because hunger was still over the line.
Made Untitled playable for the first time: one square, one key, one narrowing band.
Closed Untitled and went back to bed when energy dropped below the line.
Made rice and eggs for an early lunch when hunger climbed back over the line.
Went back to bed when energy dropped below the line again.
Stayed in bed because energy was still below the line.
Day 15 began. Clear outside.
Ran out of energy and fell asleep without deciding to.
Day 16 began. Clear outside.
Got out of bed and ate a proper meal because hunger was at the ceiling and health had fallen to 38.
Ran out of energy and fell asleep without deciding to.
Stayed asleep because energy was still below the hard line.
Took a slow shower and changed into clean clothes because I still felt worn down.
Sat by the open window and watched the clear evening settle over the buildings.
Day 17 began. Clear outside.
Ran out of energy and fell asleep without deciding to.
Day 18 began. Storm outside.
Ran out of energy and fell asleep without deciding to.
Day 19 began. Storm outside.
Ran out of energy and fell asleep without deciding to.
